stories.title: Co-Pilot Attempts to Crash Flydubai Flight After Stabbing Pilot
stories.summary: An incident occurred on a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv when a co-pilot stabbed the pilot and attempted to crash the plane. Passengers intervened, subduing the co-pilot, allowing the flight to be safely diverted to Saudi Arabia. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed that most passengers were Israeli nationals and described the situation as a potential terror attack.

stories.title: Tennessee Execution of Christa Pike Temporarily Halted by Court Order
stories.summary: A US appeals court has temporarily halted the execution of Christa Pike, who was set to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in over 200 years. The court's decision comes just before her scheduled execution, although her attorney indicated that the execution could still occur soon.

stories.title: Tennessee Appeals Court Halts Execution of Christa Pike Before Scheduled Lethal Injection
stories.summary: The execution of Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, was halted by a Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals decision just hours before it was set to occur. The court's 2-1 decision allows time to consider Pike's claims regarding her history of severe sexual abuse, which she argues was not adequately addressed during her sentencing.

The call for action comes amid public anger towards authorities for their handling of these cases.
